status: AUTHOR ONLY. The script has not been executed. No solver, native decoder, build, source edit, Git or SHA action.
admission: Consume only a closed passed upl_prestress_extended_CPU_r1_native_r1 (or explicitly GPU) check, its same-stat source run/reader/build/completion, and the existing public22 exports. Require actual exit0, native original guards, 2000000 or2000001 completed updates, actual Run frame count and completed extended identity. Refuse all existing output paths; do not launch or wait for a solver/decoder. Only metadata/file-stat binding is used, no source or archive scans.
validation: Read and validate the exact22-array layout and212bytes/ID, 7060 IDs=2060fixed+5000soil, full binary size/header, every actual frame's finite fields and sorted complete IDs, immutable P0 bits and fixed positions, original FS2/3 pressure/count records, actual signed nonempty intervals and the entire scalar+=2.5e-6 clock. Do not replace clocks by n*dt, impose501 frames or interpolate. Use the actual saved clocks and final native completion; retain the reader's original ledger/cache/history counters and gate results. Read via memory mapping; do not duplicate BI4 decoding.
outputs: One shallow prefix in tests/figures: history.csv (five fixed initial-material bands at every actual save), profiles.csv (all50 original material layers at every actual save,100 original IDs/layer), late.csv (all/top/bottom/left/right changes over the actual saved portion of the last.5 and1s), a3x3 history PNG, a2x3 pressure/stress/settlement/velocity profile PNG, a2x2 J/n/rho/kappa profile PNG and a descriptive check JSON. No per-frame/per-ID derived CSV. Raw typed22 remains authoritative and untouched. Profile PNGs select nearest genuine saved times to0/.5/1/2/3/4/5s without interpolation; CSV retains all actual saves.
pressure_definitions: Preserve native float ExcessPorePress=p-p0 separately from double current-coordinate residual p-rhoW*g*(H-z_current). p0 remains the immutable initial material hydrostatic baseline. Record actual FS2/3 p min/mean/max, their original p0 mean and current hydrostatic head so the initial approximately-196Pa free-surface offset remains explicit; negatives are never clipped by this script. Current signed hydrostatic reference is diagnostic, not an inferred moving water surface.
unfitted_reference: Use the actual float gravity9.81 andnu.33, rhoMix02072.5/rhoW1000/E20MPa/H2. At initial material depth d0=H-z0, pH=gammaW*d0, effective sigma_zz=-gammaSub*d0, effective sigma_xx=sigma_yy=nu/(1-nu)*sigma_zz, total sigma=sigma_effective-pH*I. The settlement reference is uz=-gammaSub*(H^2-d0^2)/(2*M), M=E*(1-nu)/((1+nu)*(1-2nu)); it is a restricted small-strain one-dimensional drained elastic/K0 comparison, not paper-prescribed K0, plastic equilibrium, exact SPH balance or a transient consolidation theory. Nothing is assigned to solver state. Plot positive vertical compression/downward settlement; raw tensor sign remains compression-negative. Initial/material and current depth are separate CSV columns; all profile ordinates use initial material depth explicitly.
late_review: For each requested.5/1s window, select the first actual saved state at or after final_time-window and report its actual start/end/duration/count. Report same-ID endpoint pressure RMS/max, total-stress Frobenius RMS, maximum XYZ change, mean downward settlement change, J change, kappa increment and velocity/pressure ranges across all included saves. These are descriptive changes, not a new convergence or physical pass threshold.
scope: Normal5s completion, numeric safety and small late changes are not automatic equilibrium acceptance. The exported schema has no complete acceleration/traction/reaction, so no force-balance, exact Darcy flux, water-mass or reaction inference is made. No direct stress initialization, fitting, half/reference solve, boundary change, new physical threshold or additional run is requested. Visual QA is required after the later authorized generation.
